answer_invariance.reason: design is full rank within MedQA constructions, but independent cross-source taxonomy generalization is unavailable (only one source family)

efficiency.pipeline_makespan_note: formal wall timestamps include concurrent workers, not sum of stage times; separate cold smoke/compatibility work is in performance_test.json Intermediate wall timestamps mark restarted scheduler phases; first-to-last is the complete expansion makespan. The unexpected-exit downtime and subsequent recovery are included.
efficiency.cold_vs_reused: full-test extension: exact prior screening inputs and all their stages reused; remaining inputs newly executed; no unrelated historical method answers reused

method_scope.authorization: User explicitly states only MedRGAG-Llama base is currently needed; asks whether dropping Direct/retrieval-only materially accelerates it
method_scope.coverage: All 25280 unique inputs and 27377 released/auxiliary label records retained
method_scope.M0_M1_policy: Preserve already completed predictions and all incurred costs as historical auxiliary records; no additional M0/M1 requests after scope restart
method_scope.cost_evidence: method_scope_cost.json: M0/M1 represented 5.4177% of completed expansion stage time before the change; not an exact makespan savings estimate

method_scope_cost.scope: completed new expansion requests at scope change; overlapping stage times, not pipeline makespan

method_scope_restart.reason: User explicitly narrows all remaining full-test inference to MedRGAG-Llama M2 only
method_scope_restart.strategy: Stop each task-owned inference engine immediately after its next durable complete-chunk runtime checkpoint; retrieval continues
method_scope_restart.status: Both workers stopped after successful M2 and durable chunk checkpoint; no abandoned LLM batch observed
method_scope_restart.post_restart_reader_scope_verified: new logs contain no M0/M1 calls

retrieval_prefetch.scope: final resumed retrieval prefetch phase; earlier phases retained separately, this duration is not total retrieval cost

prior_screening_reuse.reuse_basis: exact visible-input equality; item IDs, seeds, model, templates, evidence, decoding and copied stage outputs unchanged
prior_screening_reuse.input_digest_update: only after verifying the complete old input list is an identical prefix; independent cache copy preserves prior artifacts

context_capacity.reason: full released mandatory evidence plus unchanged KADS/documents exceeds previous capacity; no token budget or prompt change

incremental_expansion_workload.meaning: new requests since the full-test expansion started; earlier exact cached stages remain in total workload

controlled_capacity_restart.reason: Increase KV capacity using currently free GPU memory; prior GPU0/2 KV 153984/105616 tokens limited long-input concurrency
controlled_capacity_restart.preserved: checkpoint BF16, tokenizer, prompts, input IDs, RNG seeds, candidate/document counts and decoding budgets
controlled_capacity_restart.inflight_policy: All completed stage rows retained. At most one unreturned generation batch per engine may be interrupted; its unreturned tokens are unavailable and excluded from recorded-token totals, with restart wall time retained. No partial output is treated as a prediction.
controlled_capacity_restart.status: both engines initialized successfully; exact completed-stage caches resumed
controlled_capacity_restart.upper_bound_note: Ceiling only, not measured cost: at most 32 in-flight requests per engine and maximum stage completion limit 2048.

efficiency.recorded_token_cost_limit: Two documented scheduling/capacity restarts: at most one unreturned batch per engine per restart (four batches total); their tokens are unavailable and excluded from recorded-token totals. Full wall time includes all work and restart intervals. An additional unexpected worker exit may have lost up to one in-flight batch per engine (64 requests each); those unreturned tokens are also unknown and excluded.

controlled_throughput_restart.reason: Batch independent inputs by frozen visible token length to reduce stage barriers from mixed short questions and long mandatory evidence; use batch/chunk64 on the enlarged KV cache
controlled_throughput_restart.execution_order: ascending (reader_task_tokens, opaque item_id), then two disjoint strided shards; all 25280 inputs retained
controlled_throughput_restart.order_inputs: input_lengths.jsonl from preflight; no labels, predictions or correctness used in length ordering
controlled_throughput_restart.inflight_cost: At most one unfinished batch of at most32 requests per inference engine; unreturned token usage unavailable. Retrieval may also redo one unreturned query. Full wall time retains these costs.
controlled_throughput_restart.status: both engines initialized and executed batch64 successfully; subsequently checkpointed for explicit user M2-only scope change

unexpected_exit_restart.cause: unconfirmed: all task workers disappeared without Python traceback/failure.json or normal completion; tool sessions no longer available; kernel log access denied
unexpected_exit_restart.recovery: resume same frozen M2-only configuration and exact stage caches in detached task-owned tmux session
unexpected_exit_restart.unreturned_work: Up to one in-flight batch per inference engine (batch64); unreturned token cost unknown, excluded from recorded totals; elapsed downtime remains in full makespan.

tail_rebalance.reason: Original odd shard completed; partition remaining even shard across both existing GPUs using existing CLI
tail_rebalance.stop_policy: SIGSTOP both task-owned processes immediately after durable M2/runtime checkpoint, then SIGTERM and SIGCONT; no in-flight LLM batch observed

efficiency.cache_hits_scope: Latest durable runtime record per worker; counters restart with each process. Exact historical input reuse and input deduplication are reported separately.

repeat.interpretation: noise estimate only; no ensemble or correction; unmapped/invalid pairs excluded from semantic flip denominator and retained in raw-output change

superseded_cross_slot_seed_overlap.interpretation: noise estimate only; no ensemble or correction; unmapped/invalid pairs excluded from semantic flip denominator and retained in raw-output change

mechanism_proxies.interpretation: retrieval overlap and document-source count associations; not evidence correctness, entailment, or causal failure

evaluation_scope: entire official test/released evaluation data; no source-group sampling
